title: General Manager - Finance & Accounts

* Implement cost-control measures across all branches and workshops.
* Prepare financial forecasts for business expansion and new service locations.

* Monitor vehicle purchase invoices, sales invoices, and dealer/manufacturer settlements.
* Reconcile vehicle stock with sales records and accounting entries.
* Verify manufacturer incentives, sales commissions, dealer discounts, and applicable credit notes.
* Monitor vehicle advances, customer receipts, refunds, and outstanding balances.
* Reconcile transactions with the OEM and authorized financing partners.

* Ensure timely submission and settlement of warranty claims with the OEM.
* Monitor service-centre profitability and expenses by location.
* Review customer billing, job-card closure, discounts, and complimentary services.

4. Spare Parts & Inventory Control

* Monitor spare-parts purchases, sales, stock valuation, and gross margins.
* Reconcile physical stock with the inventory management system.
* Conduct periodic stock audits at all service locations.
* Investigate stock shortages, excess stock, damaged parts, and inventory adjustments.
* Monitor slow-moving and non-moving inventory, including EV batteries and high-value components.

5. Cash Flow & Banking

* Monitor daily cash collections, bank balances, and payment requirements.
* Ensure timely collection of customer dues, OEM receivables, and warranty claims.
* Plan supplier payments and maintain sufficient working capital.
* Review bank reconciliations, loan accounts, and interest expenses.
* Establish controls for cash handling, deposits, refunds, and online payments.

6. GST, Taxation & Statutory Compliance

* Ensure timely GST returns, TDS payments, income tax compliance, and applicable filings.
* Monitor input tax credit reconciliation and GST treatment of vehicle and spare-parts transactions.
* Ensure timely PF, ESI, and other applicable statutory payments in coordination with HR.
* Coordinate statutory audits, tax audits, and assessments.
* Track compliance deadlines and resolve discrepancies promptly.

7. Internal Audit & Financial Controls

* Conduct periodic financial audits of dealerships, workshops, and branches.
* Verify purchase orders, supplier invoices, expense vouchers, and payment approvals.
* Identify unauthorized expenses, billing discrepancies, and potential financial irregularities.
* Review discounts, credit notes, warranty claims, and cash transactions.
* Ensure closure of audit observations within the stipulated timeline.

* Reconcile dealer statements and outstanding balances with automobile manufacturers.
* Monitor OEM incentive claims, warranty reimbursements, and service campaign settlements.
* Investigate debit notes, credit notes, short payments, and disputed claims.
* Track pending claims and escalate overdue settlements.
* Maintain accurate documentation for OEM financial reviews and audits.

* Supervise accountants, branch accounts executives, cashiers, and billing personnel.
* Establish reporting deadlines and clear responsibility for each location.
* Review accounting accuracy, productivity, and compliance.
* Train staff in financial procedures, internal controls, and accounting systems.
